name: Draemony
storyline: The world has a wound, and it sings. The old ones called that song the Echo: everything it touches repeats its own pain until it becomes a monster. The roads have fallen, the dead do not rest, and only the Amber Vale still holds. From there you follow the Echo through Jataíra and Goiânthar, facing the people and places it has twisted, until the campaign reveals an older truth sealed beneath the ruined city of Hell: centuries ago an angel and a demon fought until they fused into a single being, the Xinoqs, and the Echo is its voice leaking through the seal.
summary: Draemony is a dark fantasy action RPG. Choose one of eight classes (Skeleton, Storm, Hunter, Mage, Vampire, Demon, Warrior and Barbarian), each with its own ultimate, and build your hero with a passive tree of more than a thousand nodes, class skill trees, runes and Specializations. Fight through a four-act campaign from the Amber Vale to Jataíra and Goiânthar, then push into an endless endgame of tiered Maps on the Codex of Worlds, with Abyssal Rifts, Blood Vigils and the Xinoqs pinnacle fight. Chase magic, rare and unique loot, craft with currency, a forge and runes, mine ore across the world, and play solo or in online co-op with up to 6 players.
